decisions.reason: A polymer concrete drain housing is a core building-drainage component with a long lifecycle, and it has its own page, so dropping it after one year is unlikely.
Floor-level shower drainage is Dallmer's core growth segment, so the firm will keep and develop this system rather than withdraw it.
Designer shower drains carry good margins and are featured on their own page, so the firm has reason to keep this line in the range.
The shower element with integrated slope complements the floor-level drainage portfolio, though it is only mentioned on the website, so withdrawal is somewhat more likely than for the core items.
The DallSafe 200 backflow basement drain addresses a clear regulatory and safety need and is actively promoted on the website, so the firm will keep it.
Air-admittance valves are standard drainage accessories that round out the range at low cost to maintain, so keeping them is the likely choice.
